figurative_meaning_en: The passing away of a great person
example_sentences_in_bangla: রবীন্দ্রনাথ ঠাকুরের তিরোধান বাংলা সাহিত্যের এক অপূরণীয় ক্ষতি।
স্বামী বিবেকানন্দের তিরোধানে ভারতবর্ষ শোকাহত হয়।
example_sentences_in_english: The tiródhāna of Rabindranath Tagore was an irreparable loss to Bengali literature.
India was plunged into grief by the tiródhāna of Swami Vivekananda.
history: This term originates from Sanskrit and is commonly used in Bengali literature to respectfully denote the death of revered figures like saints, poets, and leaders, reflecting a cultural reverence for spiritual and intellectual giants.
note: The term carries a dignified, non-colloquial tone, avoiding crude references to death.
